```artifact
TC-001: Self-test flow sensor accuracy validation
  Precondition: Blower set to a known speed (as specified in the system design), air lines open, nothing connected to the output.
  Step: Initiate self-test.
  Expected: Self-test passes the flow sensor accuracy check.

TC-002: Self-test pressure sensor accuracy validation
  Precondition: Pressure sensor exposed to a known pressure (as specified in the system design).
  Step: Initiate self-test.
  Expected: Self-test passes the pressure sensor accuracy check.

TC-003: Controller pre-test mode support
  Precondition: System powered on and in normal operation.
  Step: Initiate pre-test mode via controller interface.
  Expected: Pre-test mode activated without error.

TC-004: GUI pre-test mode support
  Precondition: GUI running and connected to controller.
  Step: Click pre-test mode button in GUI.
  Expected: Pre-test mode initiated and GUI displays pre-test mode status.

TC-005: Pre-test mode includes required checks
  Precondition: Pre-test mode available (as per RW-SW-150).
  Step: Initiate pre-test mode.
  Expected: Pre-test mode completes successfully, indicating all included checks were performed.
```
